text: Let me out on the brick strip on the right, alongside the construction fence.
Drop me on the asphalt next to the planted divider on the left, by the closest tree.
Can you let me out here?
The brick strip along the fence, please.

dialogue.text: Can you let me out here?
Do you mean the brick strip along the fence on the right, or the asphalt by the planted divider on the left?

text: I'd like to get out beside the red bus shelter on this bend.
I'll get out along the left curb by the red and white arrow.
Let me out at the road edge by the tall lamp on our right, just before the bend.
I'd like the striped zebra crossing in front of us.
Let me out at the foot of those white metal panels on the right.
By the nearest arrow sign on the left, on the road side of the curb, please.
The closest red and white arrow on the left.

dialogue.text: Do you mean the nearest chevron on the left, or a sign farther up the road?

text: Stop by the blue phone booth next to these panels.
Could you leave me on the sandy edge beside the base of the tall streetlamp on our right?
Actually, the curb by the arrow sign under the tree on the left, please.

dialogue.text: I first thought of getting out at the tall streetlamp on our right.

text: Pull over next to the lighthouse.
